{{NPC infobox | image = [[File:Margrid the Sly Corsair armor.jpg|150px]] | type = Human | affiliation = Corsairs | profession = r | service = Hero | level = 18..20 | campaign = Nightfall }} {{quotation|nightfall|''Seafaring Scoundrel''
"Risks? So there are risks. That's just part of doing business."
'''Origin:''' Corsair
'''Age:''' 27
'''Profession:''' Ranger
A native of [[Freeman's Cove]], [[Margrid the Sly|Margrid]] was born a sailor. She took her first steps on the rolling deck of a sailing ship, and she proudly claims to have sea water in her veins. She's not just a [[corsair]]—she's the descendant of generations of corsairs, a woman who knows no other way of life. Life on land seems strange, predictable, and dull by comparison. People on land have vastly different ideas about morality and business, but for her, the Code of the Corsair is as immutable as the laws of nature. Land-dwellers sometimes regard her as a little shady, overly cynical, and blatantly self-interested, but those qualities are essential to anyone who survives in a world troubled by pirates and thieves. She's learned to roll with the punches, coping with everything life throws at her. Anyone who travels with Margrid should be ready for an exciting, dangerous journey. If Margrid has anything to say about it, the venture will be eminently profitable as well.}} ==Locations== *[[Kourna]] **{{NPC location|Command Post}} (after completing either [[No Me, No Kormir]] or [[To Kill a Demon]]) **{{NPC location|Gandara, the Moon Fortress}} (during No Me, No Kormir) **{{NPC location|Jahai Bluffs}} (as Margrid, during [[Mysterious Message (Nightfall quest)|Mysterious Message]]) **{{NPC location|Marga Coast}} (during [[For a Price]]) *[[Realm of Torment]] **{{NPC location|Throne of Secrets}} ==Missions== :''R indicates that Margrid the Sly must be in the party'' *Kourna **{{NPC location|Pogahn Passage}} R **{{NPC location|Venta Cemetery}} *[[Vabbi]] **{{NPC location|Dasha Vestibule}} R ==Quests== :''R indicates that Margrid the Sly must be in the party'' '''Quests given:''' *[[For a Price]] *[[No Me, No Kormir]] *[[Fish in a Barrel]] R *[[You Can Run...]] R *[[Gain Margrid]] '''Quests involved in:''' *[[Mysterious Message (Nightfall quest)|Mysterious Message]] *[[Greed and Regret]] R *[[A Question of Morality]] R ==Recruitment== [[File:MargridUnlocked.jpg|right]] Complete the primary quest [[No Me, No Kormir]], which is the follow-up quest to [[For a Price]]. For a Price is offered right after completion of the [[Mysterious Message (Nightfall quest)|Mysterious Message]] quest, together with a mutually exclusive primary quest [[Secrets in the Shadow]]. The latter quest leads to the recruitment of the [[Master of Whispers]]. As such, completing Secrets in the Shadow will prevent the recruitment of Margrid until after the completion of the Nightfall campaign where you can receive the quest [[Gain Margrid]] to recruit her. ==Skills== 7 [[Expertise]], 10 [[Wilderness Survival]], 11 [[Marksmanship]] *{{skill icon|Apply Poison}} *{{skill icon|Crossfire}} *{{skill icon|Distracting Shot}} *{{skill icon|Natural Stride}} *{{skill icon|Troll Unguent}} *{{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}} ==Armor== Margrid starts out with Corsair Armor, with a Corsair Mask for a headgear. Her armor is similar to standard ranger armor, with the [[armor rating]] of 64 to 70, depending on her level. The appearance of her armor can be upgraded to [[Ancient armor]] using [[Ancient Armor Remnants]] acquired from the [[Remains of Sahlahja]] [[Challenge Mission]]. The appearance of her armor can be upgraded to [[Primeval armor]] using [[Primeval Armor Remnants]] acquired in the [[Domain of Anguish]] and during [[the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]] mission. See Margrid the Sly's [[Margrid the Sly/Armor gallery|armor gallery]]. ==Dialogue== Kourna: :''"A corsair's life is simple: sea, ship, and silver, or in this case...cold Istani coin.
